title: Standalone ORBIT standard repository
intent: Move the ORBIT specification, schemas, examples, validator, and skills into an independent repository while the website remains in agent-sdlc-site.

outcomes.title: The ORBIT standard has one portable source repository.
ORBIT records and cross-record invariants are validated in CI.
Agents can create, reconcile, and validate ORBIT records through repository skills.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The repository contains the specification, four schemas, examples, and licensing terms.
A local validator checks every example against its schema and checks cross-record references.
The first skills create a Plan and validate an Orbit record without requiring the website repository.
